label: A
text:
A: Hello, Tony. Lingling and I went to Lao She Teahouse last night.
B: ___
A: It was great! You know, I always wanted to go there.
B: ___
A: We drank tea and watched an opera.
B: ___
A: No, it was difficult to understand the words. But the actors and actresses were excellent.
B: ___
A: We only planned to watch for an hour, but in the end, we stayed for three hours.
B: Did you enjoy it?
A: Well, it was interesting. ___
B: So do I. I'm also interested in traditional Chinese culture.
translation:
A：你好，托尼。昨晚我和玲玲去了老舍茶馆。
B：___
A：太棒了！你知道，我一直想去那里。
B：___
A：我们喝了茶，还看了一场歌剧。
B：___
A：不，台词很难听懂。但是男女演员都非常出色。
B：___
A：我们原本只打算看一个小时，但最后待了三个小时。
B：你们喜欢吗？
A：嗯，挺有意思的。___
B：我也是。我也对中国传统文化感兴趣。
options: What did you do in Lao She Teahouse?
I hope to see more operas next time.

questions.explanation: 根据答语“It was great!”可知，此处是在询问对方对老舍茶馆之行的看法。How was it?（怎么样？）符合语境，故选 A。
根据答语“We drank tea and watched an opera.”可知，此处是在询问在老舍茶馆做了什么。What did you do in Lao She Teahouse? 符合逻辑，故选 B。
根据答语“No, it was difficult to understand the words.”可知，此处是一个一般疑问句，且与“能否听懂”有关。Did you understand the opera? 符合语境，故选 C。
根据答语“We only planned to watch for an hour, but in the end, we stayed for three hours.”可知，此处是在询问待了多长时间。How long did you stay? 符合题意，故选 D。
根据答语“So do I. I'm also interested in traditional Chinese culture.”可知，此处表达的是“希望下次能看更多歌剧”之类的意愿。I hope to see more operas next time. 符合语境，故选 E。

label: B
text:
A: Are there any activities to do after class in our school, Liu Yan?
B: Yes, we can join many clubs.
A: Which club do you join?
B: The English Club.
A: ___
B: We do many things, such as watching English films, listening to English songs and reading English stories.
A: ___
B: That's right. I have improved my listening and speaking. I have got to know a lot about the world through reading as well.
A: Excellent! ___
B: There are twenty students.
A: ___
B: We go there once a week.
A: ___
B: Of course. Welcome!
translation:
A：刘燕，我们学校课后有什么活动吗？
B：有，我们可以参加很多俱乐部。
A：你参加了哪个俱乐部？
B：英语俱乐部。
A：___
B：我们做很多事情，比如看英语电影、听英语歌曲和读英语故事。
A：___
B：没错。我的听力和口语都提高了。通过阅读，我也了解了很多关于世界的知识。
A：太棒了！___
B：有二十个学生。
A：___
B：我们每周去一次。
A：___
B：当然。欢迎！
options: What do you do in it?
These are good ways to learn English.
How many students are there in the club?
How often do you go to the club?
Who else is going to be there?
How long have you been in the club?

questions.explanation: 根据答语“We do many things, such as watching English films...”可知，此处是在询问在俱乐部里做什么。What do you do in it? 符合语境，故选 A。
上文 B 介绍了看电影、听歌、读故事等活动，下文 B 又说这些活动提高了听力和口语、增长了见识，说明 A 在肯定这些是好的学习方式。These are good ways to learn English. 符合逻辑，故选 B。
根据答语“There are twenty students.”可知，此处是在询问俱乐部里学生的人数。How many students are there in the club? 符合语境，故选 C。
根据答语“We go there once a week.”可知，此处是在询问去俱乐部的频率。How often do you go to the club? 符合语境，故选 D。
根据答语“Of course. Welcome!”可知，A 在询问是否可以加入俱乐部。Can I join you? 符合语境，故选 E。

label: C
text:
A: Hi, Jack! Where are you going?
B: ___
A: But we don't have any lessons on Saturdays. ___
B: Because I'm going to practise playing football.
A: ___
B: At 10 am. We all arrive as early as we can so that we have time to warm up.
A: How about your training?
B: We're training harder than usual, and we want to do better.
A: Great! By the way, I hear you're going to have a big match next week. ___
B: New Stars.
A: It's also my favourite team. They always try hard to win.
B: Yes, I agree with you. But we're playing better as a team now.
A: Good luck! ___
B: Thank you very much.
translation:
A：嗨，杰克！你要去哪里？
B：___
A：但是我们周六不上课啊。___
B：因为我要去练习踢足球。
A：___
B：上午10点。我们都尽量早到，这样就有时间热身。
A：训练怎么样？
B：我们比平时训练得更努力，我们想做得更好。
A：太棒了！顺便问一下，我听说你们下周有一场大赛。___
B：新星队。
A：那也是我最喜欢的球队。他们总是努力争取胜利。
B：是的，我同意。不过我们现在作为一个团队配合得更好了。
A：祝你好运！___
B：非常感谢。
options: When do you start the practice?
I do hope you will win!
Will Mr White come to watch your match?

questions.explanation: 上文 A 问“Where are you going?”，B 回答要去的地方。I'm going to school. 符合语境，故选 A。
下文 B 回答“Because I'm going to practise playing football.”，说明 A 问的是去学校的原因。Why are you going there? 符合逻辑，故选 B。
下文 B 回答“At 10 am.”，这是时间，所以 A 问的是练习开始的时间。When do you start the practice? 符合语境，故选 C。
下文 B 回答“New Stars.”，这是一个队伍名称，所以 A 问的是和谁比赛。Who are you playing against? 符合语境，故选 D。
上文 A 说“Good luck!”，接着表达希望对方赢的愿望。I do hope you will win! 符合语境，故选 E。

label: D
text:
A: Can I help you?
B: Yes, please. I want to buy a schoolbag for my son.
A: ___ does he like?
B: He likes black. ___ is this one?
A: It's 150 yuan.
B: Oh, it's a little expensive. ___ you ___ a cheaper one?
A: Sure. ___ this black one? It's only 90 yuan.
B: It looks nice. ___ I ___ a look at it?
A: Of course. Here you are.
B: It's good. I'll take it.
A: Thank you.
translation:
A：需要我帮忙吗？
B：是的，我想给我儿子买一个书包。
A：他喜欢什么颜色？
B：他喜欢黑色。这个多少钱？
A：150 元。
B：哦，有点贵。有便宜一点的吗？
A：当然。这个黑色的怎么样？只要 90 元。
B：看起来不错。我可以看一看吗？
A：当然，给您。
B：很不错，我买了。
A：谢谢。

questions.explanation: 根据答语“He likes black.”可知，售货员问的是颜色。What colour 符合语境，故选 A。
根据答语“It's 150 yuan.”可知，顾客问的是价格。How much 符合语境，故选 B。
顾客觉得贵，想找更便宜的，且该空由两个词构成。Do you have a cheaper one? 是购物场景中询问“有没有更便宜的”的固定表达，故选 C。
售货员推荐另一款黑色书包，What about this black one? 用于提出建议，符合语境，故选 D。
顾客想仔细看看书包，Can I have a look at it? 是请求试看的固定表达，故选 E。

label: E
text:
A: Excuse me. Could you tell me the way to the city library?
B: Sure. Go along this street and ___ at the second crossing.
A: ___ is it from here?
B: It's about twenty minutes' walk. You can take the No.7 bus.
A: ___ the bus stop?
B: It's over there, next to the supermarket.
A: Thanks a lot.
B: ___.
translation:
A：打扰一下，你能告诉我去市图书馆的路吗？
B：当然。沿着这条街走，在第二个十字路口左转。
A：离这儿有多远？
B：步行大约 20 分钟。你可以乘坐 7 路公交车。
A：公交车站在哪里？
B：就在那边，超市旁边。
A：非常感谢。
B：不客气。

questions.explanation: 指路时与“at the second crossing”搭配的是“在第二个十字路口左转/右转”。turn left 符合问路对话的常见走向，也与下文“沿着这条街走”衔接自然，故选 A。
根据答语“It's about twenty minutes' walk.”可知，A 问的是距离。How far 符合语境，故选 B。
根据答语“It's over there, next to the supermarket.”可知，A 问的是公交车站在哪里。Where is the bus stop? 符合逻辑，故选 C。
上文 A 说“Thanks a lot.”，B 应回答“不客气”。You're welcome. 是固定应答，故选 D。
